notes.title: How to watch specific video on Youtube
notes.content:
[h1]How to watch specific video on Youtube[/h1]
1. Copy video URL from your we browser.
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28335167/2facfdc907c040eb0633e5cbaa3f08045b3b8d21.jpg[/img]

2. Click the library on the left side manual of SourVR desktop software
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28335167/c0ff48c2779af8f195d686384a74db6b3b2569a5.jpg[/img]

3. Past the URL into the textbox and click on open button
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28335167/5efb1df74bf76df9720da08132e260c607be0358.jpg[/img]
